title: Bind BFF strategy list and StrategySpec list to the existing Registry HTTP StrategySpec owner without new store or fallback

changes.summary: Added RegistryService.list_all_entries() projecting store.list_all_entries() into RegistryEntryView objects.
Added tenant-scoped GET /api/registry/strategy-specs and shared _filter_strategy_spec_views enforcing _authenticate_registry_read, _can_read, and X-Tenant-Id caller-tenant alignment.

Removed process-local services.registry.storage.get_store() import and try/except Exception: pass fallback from list_strategy_specs(); bound list_strategy_specs() and _resolve_canonical_strategy_spec() to _fetch_canonical_strategy_specs() over HTTP with deterministic semver+timestamp version ordering and fail-closed 403/503 error mapping.
Validated canonical list payload shape in GET /bff/strategies and projected strategy DTOs directly from canonical summary/current-version fields without per-row detail HTTP fanout.

1_canonical_registry_list_readback.details: GET /bff/strategies, GET /api/v1/knowledge/strategy-specs, and DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort.list_strategy_specs() read canonical StrategySpec entries from the Registry HTTP owner (GET /api/registry/strategy-specs) using caller authorization and verified caller tenant.

2_deterministic_version_projection_and_n.details: Removed in-process services.registry.storage.get_store() and except Exception: pass from list_strategy_specs(). Canonical current_spec_version_id, current_spec_version, version_count, lifecycle_state, title, persona_ids, and last_modified_at are projected from Registry entries ordered deterministically across multiple versions of the same strategy_id.

3_empty_and_fail_closed_semantics.details: Legitimate empty tenant Registry returns 200 with items: [] and total: 0; foreign-tenant entries or 401/403 owner responses fail closed with 403 FORBIDDEN; unavailable Registry, unconfigured Registry URL, missing caller authorization, or malformed Registry payloads fail closed with 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.

4_focused_unit_and_integration_tests.details: Added focused tests in services/registry/test_service.py, services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_research_knowledge_source_ports.py, and services/control-plane/bff/test_kw05_strategy_spec_contract.py.
